evaluations.evidence: view a list of sponsors
evaluations.rationale: Backlog includes sponsor creation/management and sponsorship purchase flows, so sponsor data can exist to be listed.

evaluations.evidence: view a list of user profiles
evaluations.rationale: Backlog includes user registration and profile update, which provides the necessary capability to create/maintain profiles to list.

evaluations.evidence: email all the trainers at once from the website
evaluations.rationale: Requires a defined way to identify/maintain the set of 'trainers' (trainer accounts/role assignment) but backlog lacks a story to create/assign trainer role or manage trainer roster.

evaluations.evidence: have a very clear map where the buildings and rooms are
evaluations.rationale: Map depends on venue/building/room/location data; backlog has venue management but no explicit story to create/maintain buildings/rooms (beyond assigning rooms to timeslots) or to publish a campus/building map dataset.

evaluations.evidence: edit my training node myself
evaluations.rationale: Training content is established elsewhere (training landing/list/detail pages), so editing complements existing training content capabilities.

evaluations.evidence: limit to one registration per day per authenticated user
evaluations.rationale: Backlog includes training registration-related workflow elements (waitlist, cancellation terms/deadline, viewing signed-up trainings), implying registration exists to constrain.

evaluations.evidence: admin view that helps track registration status for each attendee ... attended, refunded, no show
evaluations.rationale: Tracking 'refunded' and 'no show' implies capabilities to mark attendance/no-show and to perform refunds for training registrations; backlog has sponsorship refunds but no explicit training registration refund/attendance marking story.

evaluations.evidence: be added to a training waitlist
evaluations.rationale: Waitlist complements an implied training registration process present across multiple training stories.

evaluations.evidence: must accept the cancellation terms with a checkbox
evaluations.rationale: Cancellation terms acceptance complements the registration/cancellation workflow referenced elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: tie in a cancellation deadline to whatever registration / cancellation workflow exists
evaluations.rationale: Backlog references a cancellation workflow but does not include a story that actually enables trainees to cancel a training registration (the complementary 'cancel registration' capability).

evaluations.evidence: add to "my schedule" if there is a schedule feature on the site
evaluations.rationale: Backlog includes viewing the schedule but lacks a complementary capability to create/manage a personal schedule (add/remove items) beyond this conditional story.

evaluations.evidence: see which trainings I have signed up for
evaluations.rationale: Training registration is implied by training pages including 'link to register for class' and registration constraints/waitlist stories.

evaluations.evidence: view ... shows all attendee information
evaluations.rationale: Requires that trainees can register for trainings and that attendee info is captured; backlog lacks an explicit story for training registration submission (register for a training).

evaluations.evidence: admin view where all trainee information is shown and can be filtered to show a single training session
evaluations.rationale: Admin view depends on training registrations/attendee records; backlog lacks an explicit story enabling users to register for a training session (creation of those trainee records).

evaluations.evidence: link to register for class
evaluations.rationale: Story exposes need for a training registration capability, but backlog does not include a clear story for actually registering for a training (creating a training registration).

evaluations.evidence: register now link
evaluations.rationale: Requires a training registration feature; backlog has constraints and views around training registrations but no explicit story to perform the registration action.

evaluations.evidence: promote call for trainings
evaluations.rationale: A 'call for trainings' implies a submission/selection workflow for trainings, but backlog lacks a story for trainers to submit a training proposal (creation of training offerings).

evaluations.evidence: link on the home page to a list of training options
evaluations.rationale: Training list/landing pages exist in backlog, so adding a home-page link is complementary and not missing prerequisites.

evaluations.evidence: find out where the coding lounge is and what time it is open
evaluations.rationale: Requires content/data about the coding lounge location and hours; backlog lacks a story to create/maintain coding lounge info (venue page alone does not specify this specific space/hours).

evaluations.evidence: refund sponsorship money that was processed via stripe
evaluations.rationale: Backlog includes sponsorship payment flows, providing the complementary 'charge/payment' capability needed before refunds.

evaluations.evidence: link on the sponsorships page to become a $350 level sponsor
evaluations.rationale: Backlog includes the capability to pay for and become a $350 sponsor, so the link has its complementary flow.

evaluations.evidence: See a list of attendees associated with this company
evaluations.rationale: Requires a way to associate attendees/users with a company/sponsor organization; backlog lacks a story to capture/maintain attendee-to-company affiliation.

evaluations.evidence: identify myself as and pay for a $350 company sponsorship
evaluations.rationale: Complementary payment entry/charge and sponsorship level discovery exist in backlog.

evaluations.evidence: create and maintain venues
evaluations.rationale: Venue creation/maintenance complements venue viewing and directions stories.

evaluations.evidence: view venue details
evaluations.rationale: Backlog includes venue creation/maintenance, enabling venue details to exist.

evaluations.evidence: see a list of the sessions associated with sponsor attendees
evaluations.rationale: Requires (1) mapping sponsor attendees to a sponsor/company and (2) mapping attendees to sessions; backlog lacks explicit stories for attendee-company affiliation and attendee-session association.

evaluations.evidence: See a payment page ... third step of the registration process
evaluations.rationale: Backlog includes entering payment info and charging the card for individual sponsorships, supporting this payment page step.

evaluations.evidence: assign sponsors to events, trainings and summits
evaluations.rationale: Backlog includes sponsor listing/detail and sponsor-sponsored-items viewing, so assignment supports those views.

evaluations.evidence: see all events, trainings and summits that a sponsor is sponsoring
evaluations.rationale: Backlog includes admin assignment of sponsors to events/trainings/summits, enabling this view.

evaluations.evidence: Enter payment information and have my card charged
evaluations.rationale: Backlog includes payment page step and refund capability, forming a coherent payment lifecycle.

evaluations.evidence: link BADCamp attendees to my sponsorship page
evaluations.rationale: Requires a mechanism to associate specific attendee profiles with a sponsor page; backlog lacks a story to create/manage these attendee-to-sponsor links.

evaluations.evidence: update my user profile
evaluations.rationale: Backlog includes user registration (account creation), enabling profile updates.

evaluations.evidence: sign up for the BADCamp newsletter
evaluations.rationale: Newsletter signup implies a complementary capability to manage/send newsletters (campaign creation/distribution) which is absent from the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: tag my blog posts for consumption by Drupal Planet
evaluations.rationale: Backlog includes creating blog posts, so tagging them is complementary and feasible.

evaluations.evidence: create blog posts
evaluations.rationale: Backlog includes reading the blog and WYSIWYG support for long-form content, supporting a complete blog feature.

evaluations.evidence: read the blog
evaluations.rationale: Backlog includes blog post creation, enabling content to read.

evaluations.evidence: sponsor a summit
evaluations.rationale: Requires a complementary capability to process summit sponsorship purchase/commitment (e.g., select summit + pay/confirm sponsorship); backlog has general sponsorship payment but no explicit flow for summit sponsorship transactions.

evaluations.evidence: register for a summit
evaluations.rationale: Backlog includes viewing seats left, viewing signed-up summits, and coordinator attendee lists, which complement summit registration.

evaluations.evidence: get detailed directions to the summit venue
evaluations.rationale: Backlog includes venue creation/maintenance and venue detail viewing, enabling directions content.

evaluations.evidence: see what summits I'm signed up for
evaluations.rationale: Backlog includes summit registration, enabling a list of signed-up summits.

evaluations.evidence: see a list of attendees signed up for my summit
evaluations.rationale: Backlog includes summit registration, which creates the attendee list to view.

evaluations.evidence: list basic information about my summit
evaluations.rationale: Requires a complementary capability to create a summit entity/page (not just list info); backlog lacks an explicit story for summit creation/management by coordinators/admins.

evaluations.evidence: list sponsors for my summit
evaluations.rationale: Listing summit sponsors requires a way to add/assign sponsors to a summit; backlog has sponsor assignment to events/trainings/summits generally, but no summit-side workflow tying summit sponsorship (BC-037) into that list is defined.

evaluations.evidence: list an agenda for my summit
evaluations.rationale: Agenda listing implies creating/managing agenda items/sessions within a summit; backlog lacks stories to create/maintain summit agenda entries.

evaluations.evidence: see how many seats are left for the summit
evaluations.rationale: Seat counts can be derived from summit registration and capacity; summit registration exists in backlog.

evaluations.evidence: see specific details on summits ... register for the event
evaluations.rationale: Summit detail pages require summit content to be created/maintained; backlog lacks an explicit summit creation/maintenance story.

evaluations.evidence: see a list of all the summits
evaluations.rationale: Listing summits requires summits to be created/maintained; backlog lacks an explicit story to create/manage summits.

evaluations.evidence: learn about sponsorship levels
evaluations.rationale: Backlog includes sponsorship purchase flows that depend on sponsorship levels, so this informational capability fits within a complete sponsorship feature set.

evaluations.evidence: use a WYSIWYG editor for all long-form content
evaluations.rationale: Supports multiple content-creation stories (e.g., blog posts) and does not expose a missing complementary capability.

evaluations.evidence: Link to my sponsorship profile from my job listings
evaluations.rationale: Backlog includes sponsor profile personalization and job posting, enabling job listings to link back to sponsor profiles.

evaluations.evidence: learn about posting jobs as a sponsor and contact the sponsorship person
evaluations.rationale: Backlog includes sponsor job posting, so informational/contact page is complementary rather than exposing a missing core capability.

evaluations.evidence: post a job
evaluations.rationale: Backlog includes viewing the job board, completing the basic create/read loop for jobs.

evaluations.evidence: view the job board
evaluations.rationale: Backlog includes job posting, enabling jobs to exist to view.

evaluations.evidence: assign a room to a time slot and a location
evaluations.rationale: Assigning rooms/time slots requires that rooms and time slots exist as manageable entities; backlog lacks explicit stories to create/maintain rooms and time slots (beyond this assignment action).

evaluations.evidence: see the schedule
evaluations.rationale: Viewing a schedule requires schedule data to be created/populated; backlog has room/time assignment and session acceptance but lacks an explicit story to create/manage time slots/schedule entries comprehensively.

evaluations.evidence: see the final list of sessions approved
evaluations.rationale: Backlog includes session submission and acceptance/approval actions, enabling an approved list to exist.

evaluations.evidence: bulk approve sessions as accepted
evaluations.rationale: Complements session submission and accepted-session listing/scheduling stories.

evaluations.evidence: mark a session as accepted
evaluations.rationale: Complements session submission and enables schedule population and approved-session lists.

evaluations.evidence: receive a notification when sessions have been evaluated
evaluations.rationale: Backlog includes session submission and acceptance decisions, providing the triggering events for evaluation notifications.

evaluations.evidence: receive a notification when I submit a session
evaluations.rationale: Backlog includes session submission, enabling submission confirmation notifications.

evaluations.evidence: edit my session
evaluations.rationale: Backlog includes session submission, so editing complements existing session creation.

evaluations.evidence: register to speak ... submit a session
evaluations.rationale: Backlog includes session submission and evaluation workflow, so speaker registration/submission is supported.

evaluations.evidence: submit a session ... get my session evaluated
evaluations.rationale: Backlog includes acceptance/approval and notifications, completing the evaluation lifecycle.

evaluations.evidence: personalize my sponsorship page
evaluations.rationale: Backlog includes becoming a sponsor and sponsor detail/listing features, so personalization complements existing sponsor pages.

evaluations.evidence: see a list of all the summits that include when they are
evaluations.rationale: Requires summits (with dates/times) to be created/maintained; backlog lacks an explicit summit creation/maintenance story.

evaluations.evidence: offered several choices of individual sponsorship on the second page of registration
evaluations.rationale: Backlog includes payment page and charging card for individual sponsorships, supporting a multi-step registration/payment flow.

evaluations.evidence: find a link in the menu that links to the registration form
evaluations.rationale: Backlog includes the registration form story, so the menu link has its complementary target.

evaluations.evidence: fill out a user registration form
evaluations.rationale: Backlog includes profile viewing/updating, which complements account creation.

evaluations.evidence: find session information
evaluations.rationale: Backlog includes session submission, acceptance, and approved-session listing, enabling session information to exist and be discoverable.
